ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the attached figure, x(t) is a positive rectangular pulse, the top height is labeled as 1, the rectangle extends from t = -1 to t = +1, and outside this interval it is 0. Then reason: Therefore |x(t)|^2 equals 1 on [-1,1], and is 0 elsewhere, and the time-domain energy is ∫_{-∞}^{∞}|x(t)|^2 dt = ∫_{-1}^{1}1^2 dt = 2. Using the standard angular-frequency Fourier transform convention, Parseval's theorem gives ∫_{-∞}^{∞}|x(t)|^2dt = (1/(2π))∫_{-∞}^{∞}|X(ω)|^2dω. So ∫_{-∞}^{∞}|X(ω)|^2dω = 2π × 2 = 4π.
